title: alysicarpus cylindricus
intro: Alysicarpus cylindricus, commonly known as Round Stemmed Alysicarpus, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative properties. The health benefits of Alysicarpus cylindricus include the treatment of fever, skin conditions, and digestive issues, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
